sections.h2: Gujarat took 49 per cent of India's FY2025-26 wind additions

chart.title: Gujarat added 2,965 MW in FY2025-26, more than double Karnataka's 1,379 MW
chart.sub: Wind capacity added in FY2025-26, MW, by state.
chart.source: MNRE, as reported in this post.

sections.means: Gujarat's 2,965 MW was more than double Karnataka's 1,379 MW, so it now drives new wind build in India.
sections.todo: Check the next state-wise MNRE release to see whether Gujarat's share of new additions holds near 49 per cent.

sections.h2: India's installed wind is 8.4 per cent of NIWE's 120m potential

chart.title: Built capacity covers under a tenth of the 120m resource NIWE mapped
chart.sub: Installed wind as a share of NIWE's technical potential at 120m hub height, %.
chart.source: MNRE; NIWE wind atlas, via this post.

sections.means: Installed capacity is well under a tenth of the 120m resource NIWE mapped, so build-out, not wind, is the limit.
sections.todo: Address the transmission, land and repowering-pace constraints the post names, since the resource is not the limit.

sections.h2: Offshore wind has about 70 GW of potential and no commissioned turbines

sections.means: No offshore turbine has been commissioned, and GWEC expects only around 2 GW by 2035 against about 70 GW of potential.
